name: Helmfile
summary: Declarative spec and CLI for deploying Helm charts, Kustomize configs and Kubernetes manifests as Helm releases.
use_cases: keep chart value files in version control
apply CI/CD to Kubernetes configuration changes
periodically sync clusters to avoid environment skew
features: declare and apply desired Helm release state
reuse infrastructure modules via Git or S3
deploy kustomizations and manifests as Helm releases
patch Kubernetes resources without forking charts

usage_guide.open_hint: Run `helmfile create <project>` to start a new project with a helmfile.yaml.

features.feature: declare and apply desired Helm release state
features.title: Declare the Helm releases you want and apply them
steps: Write a helmfile.yaml listing each release with its name, namespace, chart and values.
Run `helmfile template -f helmfile.yaml` to render the manifests for those releases.

features.feature: reuse infrastructure modules via Git or S3
features.title: Reuse infrastructure modules from Git or S3
steps: In your helmfile, add a `helmfiles:` entry with a `path` such as `git::<repo-url>@helmfile.yaml?ref=<branch>`.
Run `helmfile template -f <file>` to render the releases from that module.

features.feature: deploy kustomizations and manifests as Helm releases
features.title: Deploy kustomizations and manifests as Helm releases
steps: Add a release whose `chart` points to a directory of plain Kubernetes manifests.
Run `helmfile template -f <file>` to render them as a Helm release.

features.feature: patch Kubernetes resources without forking charts
features.title: Patch Kubernetes resources without forking charts
steps: Add a `strategicMergePatches` list to a release, naming the resource and the fields to change.
Run `helmfile template -f <file>` to see the chart output with the patch applied.

setup.command:
set -e; mkdir -p ~/work/hf/chart/templates ~/work/hf/manifests && cd ~/work/hf
cat > chart/Chart.yaml <<'EOF'
apiVersion: v2
name: demo
version: 0.1.0
EOF
cat > chart/templates/cm.yaml <<'EOF'
apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
metadata:
  name: {{ .Release.Name }}-cm
data:
  greeting: {{ .Values.greeting | quote }}
EOF
cat > manifests/cm.yaml <<'EOF'
apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
metadata:
  name: raw-cm
data:
  from: manifests-dir
EOF
cat > helmfile.yaml <<'EOF'
releases:
- name: declared
  namespace: demo
  chart: ./chart
  set:
  - name: greeting
    value: hello-from-helmfile
EOF
cat > helmfile-manifests.yaml <<'EOF'
releases:
- name: rawdir
  namespace: demo
  chart: ./manifests
EOF
cat > helmfile-patch.yaml <<'EOF'
releases:
- name: patched
  namespace: demo
  chart: ./chart
  values:
  - greeting: original
  strategicMergePatches:
  - apiVersion: v1
    kind: ConfigMap
    metadata:
      name: patched-cm
    data:
      patchedkey: added-by-patch
EOF
rm -rf /tmp/modrepo && mkdir -p /tmp/modrepo && cd /tmp/modrepo && git init -q -b main && mkdir -p charts/modchart/templates && cp ~/work/hf/chart/Chart.yaml charts/modchart/ && cp ~/work/hf/chart/templates/cm.yaml charts/modchart/templates/ && cat > helmfile.yaml <<'EOF'
releases:
- name: frommodule
  namespace: demo
  chart: ./charts/modchart
  set:
  - name: greeting
    value: hello-from-git-module
EOF
git -c user.email=a@b -c user.name=a add -A && git -c user.email=a@b -c user.name=a commit -qm init
cd ~/work/hf && cat > helmfile-module.yaml <<'EOF'
helmfiles:
- path: git::file:///tmp/modrepo@helmfile.yaml?ref=main
EOF
echo ok

pitfalls.readme_said: Install candidates: go install / pacman / zypper / mise
pitfalls.actually_needed: Used README option 1 (binary download from GitHub releases): no Go toolchain, no pacman/zypper on Debian, mise is not installed
strategicMergePatches/jsonPatches (and kustomizations) also need the kustomize binary on PATH; without it helmfile fails with 'exec: "kustomize": executable file not found in $PATH'
No Kubernetes cluster here; checked the features with 'helmfile template' instead. helm-diff and 'helmfile init' were not needed for template
helmfile 1.8.4 templated charts with helm v4.3.2 without problems
